ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. The left tip contains a large contiguous white patch with internal black speckling. The right tip contains a smaller, more fragmented white patch. The central fluke body is composed of uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley pixel amplitude (approx. 3-8 pixels) observed particularly on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the tips toward the median notch, with a convex leading edge trajectory visible.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars/colonization) visible at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) distributed across the black surface. A prominent set of parallel diagonal lines is visible on the right lobe, with vertical disruptions near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular tissue loss/serration on the extreme right tip, and extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the right-side fluke surface.
